release_notes:
LockStepPDF 4.0.14

The program is now LockStepPDF, from LockStep Tools. This hot-fix replaces the installed program file. The zip includes ReadySetPDF.exe, which is the file name the installed updater copies, and the matching _internal folder.

Automation and OCR each start with one pipeline. Add pipeline, or the + tab, adds another. Remove this pipeline removes the pipeline you are on. The Engines bar at the top lists every automation and OCR pipeline.

Page sizes come from Global Settings. The asset size column shows one size or Pagemix. The color column shows Color, B&W, or Colormix, and follows the color tool, including Sepia.

Bleed can be set on the selected pages. The monitor can show bleed that is already in the PDF but cut off by the Media, Crop, or Trim box.

The asset list uses a book for a multi-page file and a sheet for a single page. The green dot follows the page in the Real-Time monitor. Recycle renumbers the rows and clears the old origin notes after a warning. Inserted sheets are labeled Blank. Images show in the monitor, and scrolling continues into the next file.

Recipes can live in your own folder. Reset and Load set the production destination to None, then apply a destination only when the recipe has one. Undo and Redo move one step. The stack-step grip is easier to grab, and a first launch opens that pane far enough to show the buttons. Report Bug / Feedback sends from inside the app.
